control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - gravity exposure at TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 22 November 2008 a near hit was recorded on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
